$comment: A measurement profile, not a daily one. One model, one rung per lane, pruning off, so a benchmark run measures the model and the prompt and nothing else. A rotating fleet is the right shape for working - it survives a withdrawal - and the wrong shape for comparing two arms, because the arm that happens to draw the faster route wins for a reason that has nothing to do with the change being measured. Never make this the default.
title: One model, no rotation, no pruning - for measurement
notes: Every lane runs deepseek-v4.1-flash-free and nothing else: one rung, so a spent route is a failed run rather than a quiet move to a different model. Pruning is off, so the context a run carries is the context the harness sent, not what survived a pruning pass - otherwise a benchmark would be measuring the pruner and the model at once and could not attribute either. Use it with `oc-harness use bench --yes` before a run and `fleet-safe` after; the lanes are the same ten, at the same effort levels, as the default fleet.

utility.why: The only model in the profile, so an auxiliary call cannot measure a route the lanes are not using.
